description.narrative: The expected development impact include: (i) Stakeholder Effects (Tenants): The project will increase the availability and quality of housing for students, addressing a critical need for safe and secure accommodation and supporting the retention of students in higher education institutions in India. The PBSA developments will be located in well-connected areas of major education hubs, improving safety, quality of life, and indirectly contributing to higher graduation rates. The project will also promote gender inclusion as the Platforms portfolio is expected to include female-only hostels, (ii) Environmental Effects: As part of the project, the client will pursue EDGE Certification for the PBSA portfolio, ensuring energy efficiency and reducing greenhouse gas emissions compared to comparable local buildings, and (iii) Economy-wide Effects and Contribution to Market Creation: The development of ~20,000 beds of PBSAs will lead to direct job creation during and after construction. The increase in demand for building materials and other supply chain linkages, including building management and cleaning services, increased tax revenues, and potential improvements in infrastructure, may lead to indirect job creation.

The proposed project entails an IFC equity and debt investment of up to US$18.75 million (approximately INR 1,650 million) each, aggregating to up to US$37.5 million (approximately INR 3.33 billion), in Invesdian Pte. Ltd., a newly established student housing platform (the Platform or the Company) to be managed by SPIRE Investment Manager Pte. Ltd. (SPIRE) ( https://spireim.com/ ). Roche Holdings Ltd., Mauritius, wholly owned by Mr. Shapoor Pallonji Mistry will serve as the Sponsor of the Platform. The Platform is focused on the development, ownership, and operation of a portfolio of purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) projects catering to students of higher education institutions (HEIs) in India.
